message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming data; files are loaded directly into DataFrames without any structural validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: All data is read from local filesystem paths only; there are no remote fetches, and no checksum or integrity verification is performed on any file.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation pipeline performs date filtering and resampling but contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs to defend against poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains models from scratch (LSTM, ARIMA, Prophet) and does not load any pretrained weights or serialized models, so no integrity verification (hash check, signature, pinned revision) is implemented.

No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous training samples before training begins; data is split and scaled directly without any distribution validation.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or attack methods (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are imported or invoked anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a train/validation/test split is performed via split_stock_data, there is no evidence of hashing/signing evaluation data, and no multiple independent metrics or isolation enforcement to protect against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The code loads data from files and passes it directly to models (e.g., get_news_dummies, get_stock_dummies) without any shape checks, range validation, schema enforcement, or malformed-input rejection.
No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks on model outputs are visible anywhere in the inference data-flow path.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses ARIMA, Prophet, and LSTM models for stock price forecasting — not an LLM — so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and not present.
